note: Third person. 'tts' is what the voice reads; 'cap' is the burned-in caption ('|' = chunk break). Scenes c0 and u1..u5 are the real console against the Airwallex sandbox (test money); d1 and d3 are labelled diagram cards. 'over' is an optional on-screen lower-third shown with the line.

lines.tts: This approval came 4 seconds late. So nothing was sent.
lines.cap: This approval came 4 seconds late. |So nothing was sent.

lines.tts: Rewind. A small business holds dollars, and owes suppliers in euros and pounds.
lines.cap: Rewind. |A small business holds dollars, and owes suppliers in euros and pounds.

lines.tts: Rates keep moving while an approval waits.
lines.cap: Rates keep moving while an approval waits.

scenes.name: Invoices in: a model reads, code checks

lines.tts: This is Rate-Locked Approval, on Airwallex's sandbox, with test money. A Claude model reads three invoices.
lines.cap: This is Rate-Locked Approval, on Airwallex's sandbox, with test money. |A Claude model reads three invoices.

lines.tts: Two come through clean. The third has a due time with no time zone, so the agent stops, and asks a person.
lines.cap: Two come through clean. The third has a due time with no time zone, |so the agent stops, and asks a person.

lines.tts: Separately, five hostile invoices were thrown at it. Zero wrong values. All five were held.
lines.cap: Separately, five hostile invoices were thrown at it. |Zero wrong values. All five were held.
lines.over: Separate test, five invented hostile invoices: 0 read wrong, 5 held for a person

scenes.name: Plan: balances, live rate, fund / convert / defer

lines.tts: Next, the plan. Code does this part, not the model.
lines.cap: Next, the plan. |Code does this part, not the model.

lines.tts: The plan funds Acme from euros. Globex needs pounds, so dollars get converted. Initech waits for money that's coming in.
lines.cap: The plan funds Acme from euros. |Globex needs pounds, so dollars get converted. |Initech waits for money that's coming in.

lines.tts: Now the money Initech is waiting for looks less certain. Only the decisions that depend on it are recomputed.
lines.cap: Now the money Initech is waiting for looks less certain. |Only the decisions that depend on it are recomputed.

lines.tts: Acme is not touched. Globex is checked again, and stays the same. Initech now goes to a person.
lines.cap: Acme is not touched. |Globex is checked again, and stays the same. |Initech now goes to a person.

scenes.name: Locked quote on the approver page

lines.tts: Here's the key idea. The agent may only spend at the rate a person approved.
lines.cap: Here's the key idea. |The agent may only spend at the rate a person approved.

lines.tts: For Globex, it asks Airwallex for a quote: a rate with an end time. That opens a separate approver page, sized for a phone.
lines.cap: For Globex, it asks Airwallex for a quote: a rate with an end time. |That opens a separate approver page, sized for a phone.

lines.tts: They see what they pay, what the supplier gets, the locked rate, and a countdown.
lines.cap: They see what they pay, what the supplier gets, the locked rate, and a countdown.

lines.tts: Approve in time, and the agent may use exactly this quote. Nothing else.
lines.cap: Approve in time, and the agent may use exactly this quote. Nothing else.

scenes.name: The twist: approval after expiry is refused

lines.tts: The approver gets pulled into a meeting, and the clock runs out.
lines.cap: The approver gets pulled into a meeting, and the clock runs out.

lines.tts: The tap on Approve comes too late. The app refuses. Nothing was converted, nothing was paid. The log shows zero execution calls.
lines.cap: The tap on Approve comes too late. The app refuses. |Nothing was converted, nothing was paid. The log shows zero execution calls.

lines.tts: So the agent asks for a fresh quote, and shows what changed. VARIANT_COST. Either way, it won't convert without a quote a person approved.
lines.cap: So the agent asks for a fresh quote, and shows what changed. |VARIANT_COST. |Either way, it won't convert without a quote a person approved.

lines.tts: The approver says yes to the new quote, and it goes through.
lines.cap: The approver says yes to the new quote, and it goes through.

scenes.name: Record: approved vs executed, then Verify

lines.tts: Now the record. Approved on the left, executed on the right, row by row. Twelve of twelve match.
lines.cap: Now the record. Approved on the left, executed on the right, row by row. |Twelve of twelve match.

lines.tts: Those are real Airwallex sandbox IDs. The transfer went from scheduled to paid, using the sandbox simulator.
lines.cap: Those are real Airwallex sandbox IDs. |The transfer went from scheduled to paid, using the sandbox simulator.
